description: This file defines React components for an Accordion UI element, utilizing Radix UI's Accordion primitives and Lucide icons. It provides a customizable, accessible accordion widget with subcomponents for the root, items, triggers, and content.

methods.name: Accordion
methods.description: Root wrapper component for the accordion, forwarding props to Radix UI's Accordion.Root.

methods.name: AccordionItem
methods.description: Represents an individual accordion item, wrapping Radix UI's Accordion.Item with additional styling.

methods.name: AccordionTrigger
methods.description: Toggle button for each accordion item, with icons and styling for open/closed states.

methods.name: AccordionContent
methods.description: Content area for each accordion section, with open/close animations.
